player_prompt.intro:
Nge udi Mukabula {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tuma kubula kuwa **[macro  micro]** (manzánga mawili 0-8):
• *macro*  = kibuka kilayi nge udi kubula
• *micro* = kubula ndani ya kibuka kilayi
Exemplo `[7 8]` ➜ pondelele kubula kuwa mini-kibuka 7, kubula 8, na
feka mukabula wa ku kubula kuwa mini-kibuka 8 kilayi.

Nge udi `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kubula kufwetele kubula mu ndenge ya [macro micro] na manzánga 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kala dijimbuluilu dia tokala di kala ni 0 mba 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Kibuka kilayi, mbunda, kana kubula kueta nda.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: O inzo íii io lange kiá.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mukabula afwete kubula mu kibuka kilayi.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: O kitutu kia te kiá, ki tu kuatekesa.

game_action.played: Mubadi {player_id} kubadilaku mu mini-tabuleiro {macro_idx}, kasadu {micro_idx} (linha {row}, koluna {col}). Mubadi {opponent_id} kufwete kubadilaku mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mukabula {player_id} unganja Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
